answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted identity vouching: every new agent must lock a small token deposit and be endorsed by existing peers whose own collateral is slashed if the newcomer cheats. Like a vine that needs a living trellis, each identity grows from prior attestations, so one operator cannot cheaply spawn a falcon-speed swarm of fake agents; each additional node multiplies their locked capital. Verified builders earn a lasting pearl of reputation that raises their voting weight, making mass puppet accounts far more expensive than any reward they could farm.
